issue_request: FHIR-22785 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request to add a search query parameter allowing a GraphDefinition to be applied to each search match, similar to _include/_revinclude, for R5 implementation experience.

Commit 6de659813447c8357c3c567cc7a730264c2741e6 later cleaned the summary tables while preserving _graph.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2019-08-05 confirm the 4-0-0 persuasive motion. Published R5 contains _graph. The current source still defines _graph but now links to the API Incubator GraphDefinition definition because GraphDefinition no longer lives as a core resource page; later search-page wording work, including FHIR-50203, changed 'additional resources' to 'related resources' without reversing the feature. Community searches found no later decision contradicting the application.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The latest current source and combined branch already list _graph as a result/control parameter, define it as a reference-type input to a GraphDefinition, and include it in the search control summary table.
